_meta.title: Gaiada permission catalog (IAM-01b)
_meta.status: PROTOTYPED — derived from source 2026-08-10; frozen only after owner review (IAM-07a)
_meta.keyFormat: <domain>.<resource>.<action> — domain is the owning module, or `core` for non-module kinds; the mapping to the real Cerbos kind is carried by cerbosKind/cerbosAction (e.g. search.property.update -> resource_search_property).

classes.grantable: role-assignable enforcement primitive; maps 1:1 to a Cerbos (kind, action) pair
classes.relationship: held by owning the resource (or via the hub channel for mcp_tool.call), NEVER by any role; bypass-exempt: no wildcard, no superadmin, and no future `owner` role may reach these (Ruling 3)

_meta.sensitive: assessed 2026-08-10 for step-up auth + D-10 approval routing; touches HR/people data, finance, client commitments, deploys/provisioning, credentials/identity, or cross-company access. Owner review pending — tighten additively, loosen only by owner decision.
_meta.countsNote: DERIVED from `permissions` below — re-derive rather than hand-edit. HIER-5 (2026-08-11) found this block stale after HIER-3 retired the `team` kind: it still read 61/230/215 while the array held 60/226/211. Nothing enforced it, so it drifted silently — the same hand-maintained-number rot this program has hit repeatedly. `role-permission-bundles.db.test.ts` pins the BUNDLE artifact's own counts; this block had no equivalent guard. IAM-GAP-01 (2026-08-13): 262/247/91 -> 264/249/93 — two new grantable, both sensitive: `invoice.approve` (new literal action on the existing `invoice` kind) and `hr.leave.decide` (new literal action `decide_leave` on the existing `automation_approval` kind). Kind count (68) and relationship count (15) are unchanged — no new Cerbos kind, no new relationship-class permission. P2-02 (2026-08-13): +18 grantable (4 new Cerbos kinds — role_grant/position/employee/it_account, design §6.2; role_grant/position are role-arm ONLY, permanently-unwired perm mirror per IAM-04c §9 option C; employee/it_account are role-arm only THIS wave, deferred pending their handlers). Kind count 68 -> 72 (+4). Relationship count (15) unchanged — none of the 18 new keys are relationship-class. MON-10b (2026-08-19): +14 grantable across 5 new Cerbos kinds (monitor/monitor_incident/monitor_maintenance/monitor_channel/status_page), 72 -> 77. SM-76 (2026-08-23, docs/plans/2026-08-23-seo-audit-capability.md §6): +3 grantable (search.finding.triage, search.finding.accept_risk [sensitive], search.property.attest [sensitive]) — 1 new Cerbos kind (`resource_search_finding`), 77 -> 78; `search.property.attest` is a new action on the EXISTING `resource_search_property` kind, so the kind count moves by only +1 though 2 of the 3 new keys are on the new kind. Sensitive count 106 -> 108 (+2: accept_risk and attest are both the CONCEALING/accountability direction, design §6). HR-FULL (2026-08-24, docs/blueprints/hr-department-foundation.md waves A-D): +18 grantable across 3 new Cerbos kinds (hr_policy / hr_recruitment / hr_payroll), 78 -> 81. All three are ROLE-ARM ONLY -- no perm_* mirror -- matching resource_employee.yaml's P2-02 posture: hr_recruitment's panel rules are attribute-dependent (isPanelist/isHiringManager) and a flat catalog mirror would collapse 'only for an interview you are on' into an unconditional grant over every candidate in the tenant. hr_policy's read rule COULD carry a safe mirror; it is omitted so one follow-up IAM ticket audits and wires all three together. Sensitive 108 -> 126 (+18: every new key except hr.policy.read, which reads the company's own published rules -- holiday calendar, leave entitlement -- and is deliberately broad). Counts in this block are RE-DERIVED by the loader script, not hand-edited. FINANCE-F0 (2026-08-24, docs/blueprints/finance-accounting-foundation.md): +13 grantable across 3 new Cerbos kinds (finance_config / finance_period / finance_control), 81 -> 84. All three are ROLE-ARM ONLY -- no perm_* mirror -- matching resource_hr_payroll.yaml's and resource_employee.yaml's posture: F0 is SCHEMA ONLY and the handlers do not exist yet, so a mirror would grant reach to a surface nobody can serve. finance_control's mirror is additionally blocked on the granularity gap resource_hr_case.yaml documents -- a flat key cannot say 'in a company you are staffed to', so a mirrored assign_duty would collapse into an unconditional grant over every company. The three kinds are split along SEGREGATION-OF-DUTIES lines, not code layout: closing a period (AUTHORISE) must be grantable separately from editing the chart of accounts (RECORD), because the blueprint matrix forbids one person holding journal_post + period_close. Sensitive 126 -> 137 (+11: all but finance.config.read and finance.period.read, which carry no figures). LMS-L1 (2026-08-24, docs/blueprints/lms-foundation.md): +12 grantable across 2 new Cerbos kinds (lms_course / lms_enrollment), 84 -> 86. NOTE the base moved while this was being written — concurrent sessions added kinds — so the delta is +2, not the absolute figures a stale note would imply. Both ROLE-ARM ONLY — every non-admin rule is attribute-gated (subjectUserId self, or org_unit_lead's unitAncestors containment) and a flat mirror could express neither. lms.course.read is the one NON-sensitive key: the catalogue is the company's own material, and training you cannot see is a support ticket. FINANCE-F1 (2026-08-24): +4 grantable on 1 new kind `finance_ledger` (read/verify/post/reverse). There is deliberately NO update and NO delete action: a posted journal cannot be edited or removed (FINANCE_LEDGER_IMMUTABLE), so naming them would advertise an operation that cannot succeed. `finance.ledger.post` is NOT bundled onto company_admin, because company_admin is an ADMINISTRATIVE role and creating entries in the book of record is accounting work (same ground as its exclusion from finance.period.reopen). Note this is NOT an SoD argument: finance_manager holds both ledger.post and period.close, because closing the books is the controller's job. Segregation of duties binds per company per PERSON through finance_duty_assignments + finance_sod_check(), not through role bundles — which is what lets a real conflict be waived deliberately, with a recorded compensating control, instead of being either impossible or invisible. FINANCE-F3 (2026-08-24): +2 grantable on 1 new kind `finance_statement` (read/export). No write action exists: a statement is DERIVED, so there is nothing to create or edit — a wrong figure means a wrong ledger, corrected there by reversal. `export` is separated from `read` and held at D4 high assurance because it produces an artefact that LEAVES the ERP (the bank/auditor pack, blueprint 10.4) and carries no access control once it exists. FINANCE-F4 (2026-08-24): +6 grantable on 1 new kind `finance_ar` (read/reconcile/manage/issue/receipt/write_off). The actions map onto SoD DUTIES rather than CRUD, because `ar_receipt_posting` + `ar_writeoff_approve` is a seeded BLOCKING conflict (pocket the cash, write off the debt) and is only enforceable if the two are separately grantable. As with finance_ledger, finance_manager holds both — role bundles grant CAPABILITY, the duty matrix binds per company per PERSON. FINANCE-F5 (2026-08-24): +6 grantable on 1 new kind `finance_ap`. Finer action split than finance_ar because AP carries TWO seeded blocking conflicts (vendor_master+ap_payment_release, ap_bill_entry+ap_payment_approve) and is where money actually leaves. `vendor_master` is separated specifically because editing a vendor's BANK DETAILS redirects payment on a genuine invoice — no fake bill required. `payment_release` is the narrowest grant in the finance module: module_manager only, D4 high assurance, not company_admin. FINANCE-F6 (2026-08-24): +4 grantable on 1 new kind `finance_bank` (read/reconcile/import/match). No action EDITS a statement line: the statement is the bank's version of events, and if the bank is wrong the answer is a dispute plus a correcting entry, never an edit that makes the two agree. There is also no adjustment/plug action - an unexplained difference IS the finding. Note the seeded bank_reconcile+cash_custody pair is satisfied STRUCTURALLY at the staff tier: finance_staff can reconcile but cannot release payments (F5 keeps payment_release at module_manager), so default staffing satisfies it with no configuration. FINANCE-F7 (2026-08-24): +4 grantable on 1 new kind finance_tax (read/prepare/configure/file). file is a statement to the STATE and is the highest bar in the module alongside ap.payment_release - a wrong return is a legal exposure, not an accounting error. It does NOT transmit: transmission goes through a licensed ASP/PJAP (D-F2 carve-out); it records that a return was lodged and snapshots the figures as filed. configure is separated from prepare because a tax CODE decides the tax on every future document, which is a different order of authority from preparing this month-s return. There is no unfile action - a correction is an AMENDED return, not an erasure - and no action edits a Coretax extract (it is DJP-s record, same posture as a bank statement). FINANCE-F2 (2026-08-24): +4 grantable on 1 new kind finance_posting_rule (read/process/author/activate). Authoring a rule is authoring ACCOUNTING POLICY - it decides which accounts every future event of its type lands in, so a single rule edit re-points an entire event stream without touching a journal. activate is therefore separated from author and held at D4 high assurance. process is DELIBERATELY WIDE and is the agent/automation path: it applies a mapping somebody else approved, and every posting still passes F1 guards (balance, period, account, chain, idempotency) - it cannot invent accounting, only apply it. An automation principal may hold process; it must never hold author or activate. WSK-12 (2026-08-27): +2 grantable on 1 new kind `webdev_zoneb_event` (read/record) -- role-arm only for the four DIRECT roles (company_admin/manager/owner/platform_admin); module tiers deliberately unseeded (no UI consumer yet, see the migration's own header). Sensitive +1 (record only -- an automation-identity action). WSK-19 (2026-08-27, docs/blueprints/webdesk-design.md §06): +2 grantable on 1 new kind `webdev_contract_snapshot` (read/refresh), 95 -> 96 kinds, 380 -> 382 concrete pairs, 365 -> 367 grantable. UNLIKE webdev_zoneb_event, this kind's module tier IS seeded (webdev_staff/webdev_manager) because refresh is a real console button per design §08's button matrix, not an automation-only action -- the webdev department's role pair already exists (0097/0098) so there is no unbuilt-console reason to defer it. Sensitive +1 (refresh only -- read carries no figures or credentials).
